dialect_varying_payloads.reason: OpenInference records an LLM span's whole request envelope in input.value and the whole provider response in output.value; OTel GenAI records the normalized conversation in gen_ai.input.messages / gen_ai.output.messages. One strictly contains the other plus more, so neither is a re-encoding of the other and SPEC.md 3.3 constrains neither (FIXTURES.md 4.4). Narrowed to what the cross-dialect run actually showed disagreeing. MIME, so a reader of this fixture need not open an adapter to find out: OTel GenAI emits no content-type attribute anywhere, and the otel_genai adapter nonetheless reports application/json for the four keys the convention DEFINES as structured values (ADAPTERS.md 3, 'a mime the dialect defines but does not emit'). That is why mime agrees on the llm payloads and is declared only where OpenInference reports text/plain for a bare string.
